title: DreamScript IR
description: One hand-drawn diagram, whatever its type, as a labelled directed multigraph plus provenance. Everything downstream of Phase 2 consumes this and nothing else.

ir_version.description: Major version changes when a consumer written against the old schema would break.

diagram_type.description: 'unknown' is legal and honest: the classifier of Phase 5 fills this in, and a converter that cannot tell must not guess.

source.description: Dataset or process this diagram came from, matching a key in src/ingest/registry.py where one exists.

geometry.description: How much to trust bbox and polyline. 'annotated': copied from a human-made annotation. 'derived': computed by this project from something the source did record, and therefore only as good as that derivation. 'absent': the source records structure and no positions at all - bbox and polyline are null and no geometric metric may be computed from this diagram.

image.description: Repo-relative path to the image these coordinates index. Empty when geometry is absent.

image_size.description: [width, height] in pixels. Required for the out-of-frame check in Phase 2.2.5.

producer.description: What wrote this file, e.g. 'src.ir.convert.hdbpmn'. A conversion is an experiment and gets attributed like one.
